propositions: At search exhaustion the verifier banks met=false falsely classifying absence-of-evidence as refutation, causing spurious FAIL verdicts when evidence exists but was not reached within budget
The system must distinguish three evidence outcomes (met, refuted, insufficient) carrying insufficient via a framework-set evidence_sufficient:false marker separate from bool met field
Fallback-banked insufficient entries must preserve their marker across model re-harvests unless genuinely refuted; model-facing tool remains bool-only to maintain independence
All verdict renderers (close-gate refusal, CLI output, finalizer prompt, sidecar payload) must emit marker-aware text distinguishing insufficient evidence from unmet criteria

The audit ticket page mistakenly discriminated PASS/FAIL by sidecar shape (criteria presence) rather than verdict field, requiring honest keying once FAIL payloads gain criteria for marker persistence
